name: Fire OG Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Fire OG is an indica-dominant hybrid strain, a product of its OG Kush and SFV OG Kush lineage. This strain has an aroma similar to Lemon Pledge and offers a citrusy, sweet and spicy flavor. Fire OG has potent and long lasting euphoric effects and also leads into an intense couch lock in which you'll feel sedated with an immense case of the munchies. The strain gets its very approriate name from the frosty red hairs that make the strain appear to look like it is on fire.
